<documents>
<document id="products-credit">
CreditˆcardsˆandˆloansˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆcreditˆcards,ˆpersonalˆloans,ˆmortgages,ˆautoˆloansˆorˆlinesˆofˆcredit.ˆ##ˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆisˆaˆdebitˆcardˆItˆspendsˆmoneyˆthat'sˆalreadyˆinˆyourˆaccount.ˆItˆdoesn'tˆbuildˆcreditˆhistoryˆandˆdoesn'tˆappearˆonˆyourˆcreditˆreport.ˆ##ˆIsˆCushionˆaˆloan?ˆCushionˆcoversˆsmallˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆonˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆwithˆnoˆfeesˆorˆinterest.ˆItˆisn'tˆaˆlineˆofˆcredit,ˆisn'tˆreportedˆtoˆcreditˆbureaus,ˆandˆisˆrepaidˆautomaticallyˆfromˆyourˆnextˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆCreditˆchecksˆWeˆdon'tˆrunˆaˆhardˆcreditˆcheckˆwhenˆyouˆopenˆanˆaccount.ˆ##ˆPayingˆaˆloanˆorˆcardˆfromˆanotherˆlenderˆYouˆcanˆpayˆotherˆlendersˆfromˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆbyˆACH,ˆusingˆyourˆroutingˆandˆaccountˆnumber.ˆ##ˆLookingˆforˆcredit?ˆWeˆcan'tˆrecommendˆlendersˆorˆgiveˆadviceˆaboutˆborrowing.ˆ##ˆCreditˆreportsˆBecauseˆweˆdon'tˆlend,ˆweˆdon'tˆreportˆyourˆaccountˆtoˆcreditˆbureaus.ˆAˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆwon'tˆraiseˆorˆlowerˆyourˆcreditˆscore.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="products-business">
BusinessˆaccountsˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆonlyˆoffersˆpersonalˆaccounts.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆbusinessˆaccountsˆforˆcompanies,ˆpartnerships,ˆnonprofitsˆorˆsoleˆproprietors.ˆ##ˆUsingˆaˆpersonalˆaccountˆforˆbusinessˆPersonalˆaccountsˆareˆforˆpersonalˆuse.ˆSmallˆamountsˆofˆfreelanceˆorˆsideˆincomeˆareˆfine,ˆsuchˆasˆgettingˆpaidˆforˆoccasionalˆgigs.ˆRunningˆaˆbusiness'sˆregularˆpaymentsˆthroughˆaˆpersonalˆaccountˆisn'tˆallowed,ˆandˆcouldˆleadˆtoˆaˆreviewˆofˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆBusinessˆpaymentsˆintoˆyourˆaccountˆYouˆcanˆreceiveˆpaymentsˆfromˆaˆbusiness,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployerˆorˆaˆclient,ˆintoˆyourˆpersonalˆaccount.ˆ##ˆBusinessˆdebitˆcardsˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆisˆaˆpersonalˆdebitˆcard.ˆItˆcan'tˆcarryˆaˆbusinessˆname.ˆ##ˆTaxˆformsˆWeˆonlyˆissueˆinterestˆtaxˆforms.ˆWeˆcan'tˆissueˆformsˆforˆbusinessˆincome.ˆ##ˆLookingˆforˆaˆbusinessˆaccount?ˆYou'llˆneedˆaˆbankˆthatˆoffersˆbusinessˆaccounts.ˆWeˆcan'tˆrecommendˆaˆspecificˆone.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="savings-interest-calc">
HowˆsavingsˆinterestˆisˆcalculatedˆInterestˆonˆSavingsˆPocketsˆisˆcalculatedˆeveryˆdayˆandˆpaidˆonceˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆHowˆit'sˆcalculatedˆEachˆdayˆweˆworkˆoutˆinterestˆonˆtheˆbalanceˆinˆeachˆpocketˆatˆyourˆplan'sˆrate,ˆandˆitˆcompoundsˆdaily.ˆTheˆAPYˆalreadyˆincludesˆtheˆeffectˆofˆcompounding.ˆ##ˆWhenˆit'sˆpaidˆInterestˆforˆtheˆmonthˆisˆpaidˆintoˆeachˆpocketˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth,ˆandˆshowsˆasˆ"Interest".ˆ##ˆBalanceˆcapˆYourˆplan'sˆAPYˆappliesˆtoˆcombinedˆpocketˆbalancesˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆAnythingˆaboveˆthatˆearnsˆ0.10%ˆAPY.ˆ##ˆChangingˆplansˆIfˆyouˆchangeˆplans,ˆtheˆnewˆrateˆappliesˆfromˆtheˆdayˆtheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffect.ˆInterestˆforˆearlierˆdaysˆinˆtheˆmonthˆusesˆtheˆoldˆrate.ˆ##ˆRateˆchangesˆRatesˆareˆvariable.ˆWeˆgiveˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆnoticeˆbyˆemailˆbeforeˆweˆlowerˆaˆrate.ˆYourˆmainˆbalanceˆdoesn'tˆearnˆinterest.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: What's the interest rate on Tallowbrook personal loans?
